CheckTitle: ASC for SQL Servers is enabled
Description: Verify that Azure Defender is enabled for SQL Servers.
Risk: SQL Servers may lack threat protection and vulnerability scanning.

Code.Other:
1. Go to Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
2. Open Environment Settings.
3. Select the subscription.
4. Turn on the SQL Servers on machines plan.

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Policy Ensure Asc For Sql Servers Is Enabled.
